brief.accessibility_intent: Use semantic landmarks, one clear h1, visible keyboard focus, readable contrast, a viewport declaration, and comfortable touch targets.
brief.asset_role: A geometric triage signal should carry the visual identity as an original code-native asset rather than a placeholder photo.
brief.audience: Pet owners making a high-stakes urgent-care decision at night.

exact_copy.heading: A calmer next step when every minute matters.
exact_copy.support: PulsePaw helps you assess what to do next and reach the right emergency team without adding noise.

brief.job: Orient quickly, communicate clinical confidence, and make the emergency call obvious.
must_avoid: invented testimonials or unsupported clinical claims
remote assets, scripts, and third-party fonts
must_include: semantic header, main, and footer landmarks
an original code-native triage signal visual
a strong typographic hierarchy and obvious emergency CTA
brief.outcome: A premium emergency triage hero that helps a pet owner orient quickly and contact the care team.
brief.responsive_intent: Use a composed two-column desktop hero that becomes an intentional, spacious stacked mobile composition without clipping or horizontal overflow.
brief.thesis: Calm clinical clarity with a precise signal for the next safe action.

request: Create a premium single-page hero for fictional PulsePaw Triage, an AI-assisted emergency veterinary triage service. The visual direction must feel modern, calm, trustworthy and clinically credible, with one deliberate custom visual asset and responsive desktop/mobile behavior.
title: PulsePaw emergency triage hero
